prompt: A cinematic film still captures the bustling interior of a sunlit pottery workshop. In the center, a woman in a blue apron spins a clay wheel with intense focus. To her left, a man in a red scarf holds a wet sponge, ready to assist. On the right, a child in yellow overalls watches with wide eyes. Behind the central figure, an elderly woman with gray hair leans against a wooden shelf stacked with drying bowls. Next to her, a young man in a green shirt sketches designs on a notepad. A brown dog sleeps peacefully on a rug near the kiln entrance. Above the workbench, three hanging pendant lights cast warm glows. A large window on the back wall lets in natural light, illuminating dust motes dancing in the air. A stack of white plates sits on a nearby table. A bucket of murky water rests on the floor beside the wheel. A towel hangs loosely over the shoulder of a standing apprentice in black pants. Another apprentice, wearing a striped shirt, points at a cracked vase on the display stand. The instructor, a tall man in a beige vest, looks at the cracked vase with a critical eye. A cat perches on a high shelf, observing the scene below. A rolling cart filled with tools stands next to the kiln. A pile of raw clay blocks lies in the corner. A broom leans against the far wall.
